findings.quoted_text: Work Product, and every right in it, vests in Client as it is generated.
Work Product, and every right in it, vests in Client as it is generated.
findings.explanation: The contract transfers ownership of your work to the client as it is created, before you have been paid. If the client fails to pay, they already own your intellectual property.
findings.suggested_change: Work Product, and every right in it, vests in the Client only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services or Deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for providing the agreement. I am looking forward to working with you, and I have one small suggestion before we sign. - Regarding the relevant clause on work product, the current wording transfers ownership before payment is made. I propose updating this section with the following wording: "Work Product, and every right in it, vests in the Client only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services or Deliverables." Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable. Best regards,
